description: This file defines the NotLikeOperator class, which implements a string filter operator for the SuiteCRM JSON API. It provides methods to return filter and SQL representations of the operator, and validates input operators.

classes.name: NotLikeOperator
classes.description: Implements a 'not like' string filter operator for JSON API filters, providing methods for filter representation, SQL translation, and validation.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'nli' for this operator.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL string 'NOT LIKE' for this operator.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the provided operator is a string; throws exception if not.
